n6eb1aa9881.headline: India to enter into bilateral Rupee swap agreements with SAARC countries: RBI
n6eb1aa9881.summary: The Reserve Bank of India, with the government, unveiled a revised currency swap framework for SAARC countries covering 2024 to 2027, allowing bilateral rupee swap agreements.
n6eb1aa9881.why: Currency swap lines are central-bank tools that provide liquidity and support trade settlement, and they can affect the rupee's use in regional trade.

nd3fab17c99.headline: BoE: Warning bells for real estate prices – Set at levels disproportionate to disposable income
nd3fab17c99.summary: The Bank of England warned of risks from real estate prices, which it said are set at levels disproportionate to disposable income. The warning concerns UK housing valuations.
nd3fab17c99.why: The Bank of England sets UK monetary policy and monitors financial stability, and house prices affect mortgage lending, household balance sheets and bank risk.

n6533962bbb.headline: Gassy cows and pigs will face a carbon tax in Denmark, the first country to do so
n6533962bbb.summary: Denmark will introduce a carbon tax on farm animals, including cows and pigs, making it the first country to do so. Livestock account for about 32% of human-caused methane emissions, according to the UN.
n6533962bbb.why: Carbon taxes on agriculture raise production costs for meat and dairy producers, affecting food companies and farm margins.

n7c063b7521.headline: USD/ZIG: Zimbabwe Gold steady after central bank decision - Invezz
n7c063b7521.summary: The Zimbabwean ZiG currency outlook is in focus after the latest Zimbabwe central bank decision. The article explains what to expect from the currency.
n7c063b7521.why: The Zimbabwe central bank sets monetary policy and currency arrangements, which determine the value of the ZiG against the US dollar.

n21c156a22f.headline: Silence Therapeutics Announces Positive Results from Ongoing SANRECO Phase 1 Study of Divesiran in Polycythemia Vera Patients
n21c156a22f.summary: Divesiran eliminated the need for phlebotomy in all well-controlled patients after infrequent dosing and was well tolerated in the ongoing SANRECO Phase 1 study. The company plans to host a conference.
n21c156a22f.why: Silence Therapeutics is a biotech developing RNA-based medicines, and early clinical data guide whether a drug advances to larger trials.

n1b571ed6a4.headline: Brazil's central bank raises 2024 GDP growth forecast to 2.3%
n1b571ed6a4.summary: Brazil's central bank raised its 2024 economic growth forecast to 2.3% from 1.9% predicted in March, according to its quarterly inflation report released on Thursday.
n1b571ed6a4.why: The central bank's growth and inflation forecasts guide interest-rate expectations, which matter for Brazilian bonds, the real and equities.

n8a8d364e29.headline: Global wave of elections could hit UK financial system, warns Bank of England
n8a8d364e29.summary: The Bank of England has warned that a wave of elections could affect the UK financial system. More than 80 countries are going to the polls this year, and the central bank raised concerns about newly elected governments.
n8a8d364e29.why: The Bank of England is the UK central bank and financial regulator, and its financial stability warnings shape how investors view UK risk.

nc4b82edea7.headline: Infinity Power inks 4GW Cameroonian renewables deal
nc4b82edea7.summary: Infinity Power has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Cameroon West Regional Council to develop up to 4GW of renewables capacity by 2035. The deal is at MoU stage.
nc4b82edea7.why: Large-scale renewables projects attract private capital and shape the power sector outlook in developing markets where electricity supply is often constrained.

n44cbb3590a.headline: Chinese-owned chipmaker Nexperia invests $200 mln in European expansion
n44cbb3590a.summary: Nexperia, one of the world's largest makers of basic semiconductors, plans to add capacity in energy-efficient chips. The company expects demand growth for chips used in electric vehicles.
n44cbb3590a.why: Nexperia makes discrete semiconductors used in autos and industrial equipment, and its Chinese parent Wingtech has been a focus of geopolitical scrutiny over chip supply.

n7b85b4dabd.headline: Olive Garden announces how much its menu prices will rise after reported sales decrease
n7b85b4dabd.summary: Olive Garden announced it will raise menu prices following a decrease in sales and a loss of customers. The restaurant chain is owned by Darden Restaurants.
n7b85b4dabd.why: Olive Garden is a large casual-dining brand owned by Darden Restaurants, so its pricing and traffic trends are watched as signals for the restaurant sector.

nb0cd3a53c0.headline: Seabridge Gold Reports Bronson Slope Resource Estimate at its Iskut Project in BC
nb0cd3a53c0.summary: Seabridge Gold reported its first mineral resource estimate for the Bronson Slope deposit at its 100%-owned Iskut project in British Columbia's Golden Triangle area.
nb0cd3a53c0.why: Seabridge Gold is a Toronto-based gold exploration company, and resource estimates indicate how much metal a deposit may hold, which shapes its development prospects.

n3570fa279f.headline: US dollar index (DXY) sits and waits for the PCE inflation data - Invezz
n3570fa279f.summary: The US dollar index is waiting for the upcoming US PCE inflation report, which is the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge. The article outlines expectations and key levels to watch.
n3570fa279f.why: The PCE price index is the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation measure, and it shapes expectations for US interest rates and the dollar.

impacts.name: US dollar index
impacts.why: Expectations for the PCE inflation report influence rate expectations and therefore the dollar.

n6880864129.summary: The 30-share BSE Sensex closed up 568.93 points at 79,243.18, while FMCG stocks declined as the broader market rose.
n6880864129.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies and is the main benchmark for the Indian equity market.

impacts.why: The benchmark index closed higher on the day, as reported.

nd509fa88dd.headline: Birkenstock's key shareholder to offload stock despite rosy forecast
nd509fa88dd.summary: US private equity firm L Catterton will sell part of its Birkenstock stake but will still hold the largest share of the company. The sale comes alongside a rosy forecast from the footwear maker.
nd509fa88dd.why: Birkenstock is a German footwear company listed in New York. Large shareholder sales can add supply to the stock and affect investor sentiment.

n6030245dd4.headline: Sebi amends FPIs
n6030245dd4.summary: India's Sebi has amended guidelines for registering Foreign Portfolio Investors linked to non-resident Indians, overseas citizens of India and resident Indians participating in such investments.
n6030245dd4.why: The Securities and Exchange Board of India regulates foreign portfolio investment, which affects flows into Indian equity and debt markets.

ne827cfafc3.headline: H&M shares plunge 14% after disappointing Q2 profit, cautious outlook
ne827cfafc3.summary: H&M shares fell 14% after second-quarter profit rose less than expected, and the company raised concerns about June sales and full-year margins.
ne827cfafc3.why: H&M is a global fashion retailer, and its sales and margin trends are watched as indicators of apparel demand.
ne827cfafc3.why_moved: Smaller-than-expected profit growth and cautious comments on June sales and full-year margins led investors to sell the shares.

n6b5d2fc498.headline: "Poor corporate payment ability, minimum wage should be applied selectively"… SME's public appeal
n6b5d2fc498.summary: Small and medium enterprises in South Korea appeal for selective application of the minimum wage due to poor corporate payment ability and risk of non-compliance.
n6b5d2fc498.why: Minimum wage policies affect labor costs and SME viability, influencing employment and economic growth in South Korea.

naf5edf1c1a.summary: Mozambique's National Institute of Social Action is experiencing challenges in disbursing social subsidies, affecting access to financial resources for needy populations.
naf5edf1c1a.why: Delays in social subsidy payments can impact social welfare and economic stability in vulnerable communities.

nb0efdc6fc6.summary: Toyota, Denso, and Toyota Industries plan to sell ¥178 billion worth of Aisin shares to improve capital efficiency and fund growth.
nb0efdc6fc6.why: Share sales by major automakers and suppliers can impact automotive sector valuations and investor sentiment.

nbdbb841d00.headline: Urban Company: Urban Company makes Rs 282-283 crore revenue, pre-tax profit in Q1, says founder Bhal
nbdbb841d00.summary: Urban Company, a home services platform in India, grew revenue by 38% in Q1, with a 4% profit margin before tax.
nbdbb841d00.why: Company performance reflects growth in the Indian gig economy and consumer spending on home services.

nabe6bc535a.headline: Kuwait exchange market recovery linked to black market crackdown
nabe6bc535a.summary: Kuwait's exchange market is recovering after a period of stagnation linked to a crackdown on the black market.
nabe6bc535a.why: Market recovery can influence investor confidence and capital flows within Kuwait's financial sector.

ne804ee3d94.headline: NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Jumped on Booming Demand for AI Products
ne804ee3d94.summary: NVIDIA's stock surged as demand for AI-related products remained high in the first quarter of 2024.
ne804ee3d94.why: NVIDIA is a leading supplier of AI hardware, and its performance reflects growth in the AI sector and its impact on technology markets.

n96ef06ab00.headline: Labour’s Net Zero switch will cost taxpayers nearly £800bn, warns tax expert
n96ef06ab00.summary: A tax expert warns Labour's Net Zero policies may saddle the UK with nearly £800 billion in costs if implemented.
n96ef06ab00.why: Net Zero policies involve significant investments and regulatory changes affecting energy and infrastructure sectors, impacting government spending and market expectations.

n6e8c62318b.headline: Pentagon Targets New Threat To National Security
n6e8c62318b.summary: Deputy Secretary of Defense Kathleen Hicks announced a new threat to US national security, details unspecified.
n6e8c62318b.why: New security threats can influence defense spending and geopolitical stability, affecting markets.

n9b1160b952.headline: Millions of UK households will face major mortgage payment increases in next 2 years
n9b1160b952.summary: UK households are expected to experience significant mortgage payment hikes over the next two years.
n9b1160b952.why: Rising mortgage costs can impact consumer spending, housing markets, and financial stability in the UK.

n5954f89202.headline: A Look At The Fair Value Of Poh Huat Resources Holdings Berhad (KLSE:POHUAT)
n5954f89202.summary: Analysis indicates Poh Huat Resources Holdings may be undervalued based on free cash flow models.
n5954f89202.why: Valuation assessments guide investor decisions on the company's stock in the furniture manufacturing sector.

n068c1ea1e7.headline: 'Whole series of data' before next rates call: RBA
n068c1ea1e7.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia indicates that more economic data is needed before making further interest rate moves, reflecting cautious monetary policy stance.
n068c1ea1e7.why: The RBA's rate decisions influence Australian borrowing costs, inflation, and currency, impacting investors and markets.

ndb04fd9ce6.headline: Prospect of low-priced Chinese EVs reaching US from Mexico poses threat to automakers
ndb04fd9ce6.summary: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers are setting up in Mexico to export ultra-low-priced EVs into the US market, posing a threat to American automakers.
ndb04fd9ce6.why: This development affects the competitive landscape of the North American auto industry and could influence EV market shares.
ndb04fd9ce6.why_moved: Low-priced Chinese EVs entering US market may pressure American automakers' sales and margins.

ne453912ab0.headline: Bank of England warning that world stock markets on the verge of crash!
ne453912ab0.summary: The Bank of England warned that global stock markets are at risk of a sharp correction due to high inflation and geopolitical risks.
ne453912ab0.why: The Bank's stability report highlights risks that could trigger a market correction, affecting investor confidence and asset valuations.
ne453912ab0.why_moved: The warning signals increased risk of a market correction, prompting investor caution.

na5025f9fc0.headline: Housing sales in Apr-Jun rise 5 pc annually in top 7 cities; down 8pc from Q1: Anarock
na5025f9fc0.summary: Housing sales in seven major Indian cities increased 5% year-on-year to about 120,000 units in April-June 2024 but declined 8% from the previous quarter due to rising prices.
na5025f9fc0.why: Housing sales data reflect real estate market health and consumer demand in India's major urban centers, influencing economic growth and investment.

n6e916a4e08.headline: Macquarie Borrowed Big. Now 16 Million Thames Water Users Are Picking Up the Bill
n6e916a4e08.summary: Macquarie Group's extensive borrowing has resulted in financial burdens being passed on to 16 million Thames Water customers in the UK.
n6e916a4e08.why: Macquarie is a major global infrastructure investor; its financial strategies can affect utility pricing and investor returns in essential services.

impacts.name: Macquarie Group
impacts.why: High debt levels may pressure Macquarie's financials and reputation.

n191ca4223f.summary: A study by Bank of Baroda reports that a heatwave is driving up prices of key food items and FMCG products like ice creams and fruit juices.
n191ca4223f.why: Weather-driven inflation in food and consumer goods affects household spending and inflation outlook in India.

n8218c474a4.headline: Suzlon Energy, NTPC & IEX: What Rajesh Palviya of Axis Securities says on these 3 power stocks - BusinessToday
n8218c474a4.summary: Suzlon Energy has broken above Rs 50 level, with potential for further rally according to Axis Securities analyst Rajesh Palviya.
n8218c474a4.why: Suzlon Energy is a key player in India's renewable energy sector; stock movements reflect investor interest in clean energy companies.

n348a0c4fd5.summary: Egypt's Ministry of Supply plans to distribute July ration allocations through 40,000 outlets to 64 million citizens. The 31 subsidised items have a monthly value above 4 billion pounds.
